title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study P)
description: BigP3BCI Study P is a P300-based brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 19 ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis) subjects across 2 sessions each, using a 9x8 character grid spelling paradigm. The dataset contains 32-channel EEG data sampled at 256 Hz with target and non-target visual stimulus classifications, designed for machine learning model development and BCI performance evaluation. This is Study P, a subset of the larger BigP3BCI collection, the largest public P300 BCI dataset with recordings from approximately 267 subjects across 20 studies.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 32 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency filtering. Subjects with ALS performed a P300 speller task using a 9x8 character grid with visual stimulus presentation in a laboratory setting with online feedback. Each subject completed 2 sessions with target and non-target event classifications.
